Context: 11. T.A. on Retirement

4. Time-limit.The concession should be availed by the employee during leave preparatory to retirement or within one year of the date of his retirement which can be relaxed by Administrative Ministries / Department with the approval of the F.A. concerned. -,:, Para. 2 (iii) of GIO (1), SR 147.
